cases.caption:
Hello people we love ❤ It is time to be together. 

We’re grateful to announce that seven community organizations are coming together to host a 2SLGBTQ+ community space at The Arts Guild this Saturday. 

Come as you are to discuss, react, heal, support one another, and be supported. Rain Ward of Two Bear Indigenous Wellness will be starting us off with a restorative healing space with traditional ways of knowing at 1pm, then afterwards we will open the space for community time.

Snacks and drinks will be provided, as well as some art supplies for community time. 

PLEASE NOTE: This is a closed space for the 2SLGBTQIA+ community. No need to register or RSVP. Come if you feel like being in community. 

We love you, and we’re looking forward to coming together ❤

cases.caption:
5 reasons October looks good on Summerside ✨

October is giving us plenty of reasons to make plans, grab a friend and get out of the house.

 Get creative at Art Buds | 329 Water St.

Lean into spooky season with a Halloween Floral Pumpkin Acrylic Painting Workshop on October 23, or spend an evening creating your own miniature Halloween candy bucket at Tiny Treats on October 30. A fun excuse to get crafty with friends and leave with something you made yourself.
️ https://www.artbuds.ca/creative-workshops

 Make time to unwind with Smooth Yoga with Greg | 293 Water Street.

Greg’s Autumn Wellness Series is all about resetting for the season. Choose from Aroma Yoga, Reiki Infused Yoga or Yoga Touch and settle into a warm, relaxing session designed to help release tension and leave you feeling refreshed.
️ https://www.eventbrite.com/cc/autumn-wellness-pop-up-events-in-summerside-4879721

 Treat yourself to a warm waffle at Holman's Ice Cream Parlour | 286 Fitzroy St.

Cool October days call for something warm. Stop into Holman’s for one of their warm waffles, ranging from $10.50–$15, and turn an ordinary fall afternoon into a pretty delicious one.

 Plan a night at Harbourfront Theatre | 124 Heather Moyse Dr.

Add a little mystery to your October with Mysteries of the Keyhole House. If you’re looking for something different to do after dinner or an excuse to plan a night out, this one belongs on the calendar.
️ https://harbourfronttheatre.com/shows/mysteries-of-keyhole-house/

 Try the October specials at Famous Peppers & Crafters BBQ - Summerside | 110 Water St.

Come hungry. The Mo Cheddar Mo Better burger stacks two PEI beef smash patties with cheddar, dijonaise, a crispy potato and chive patty and apple bacon relish. Or warm up with The Rough Rider, a Southwest-inspired pizza topped with BBQ pulled chicken, red onion, banana peppers, chipotle black bean and corn medley, and a taco sauce swirl.

So... which October plan are you picking first? 

#ExploreSummerside #TheCityByTheSea Tourism Industry Association of Prince Edward Island Prince Edward Island Tourism Meet PEI North Cape Coastal Drive

cases.caption:
October is packed at Harbourfront Theatre, and we’ve got something on stage for every corner of our community—from magical family mornings to high-energy tributes and mind-bending illusions!

Here is what’s coming up this month:

Frozen in Time | Sunday, Oct 11 • 11:00 AM & 2:00 PM
A cozy, sing-along family afternoon with your favorite princesses! Dress up and bring the kids for pure magic (plus VIP meet-and-greet options!).

Flashback | Tuesday, Oct 13 • 7:00 PM
Join us for a fantastic community night at the theatre—check our site for full show details!

Still Standin': A Night of Elton John & Billy Joel | Oct 15, 16 & 17 • 7:30 PM
Craig Fair and Ben Aitken back-to-back at two grand pianos, backed by a massive 16-piece orchestra. Three nights of pure piano-rock energy!

Relive the Music - 50s, 60s & 70s Show | Monday, Oct 19 • 7:30 PM
Take a walk down memory lane with a high-energy journey through three iconic decades of rock, pop, and soul classics.

Jason Cyrus Live - Beyond Limits | Friday, Oct 23 • 7:30 PM
Prepare to be amazed (and laugh until your sides hurt) as Canada’s premiere hypnotist takes the stage for an interactive night of intrigue.

Harbour Highlight: Mysteries of the Keyhole House | Friday, Oct 30 • 7:30 PM
Master illusionists Ted and Marion Outerbridge bring their spine-tingling ghost story and jaw-dropping magic straight from Hollywood's Magic Castle to Summerside!

Bonus: Join Ted and Marion for a FREE historical talk at the Eptek Art & Culture Centre on Thursday, Oct 29 at 6:00 PM to see the real 19th-century artifacts that inspired the show!

Grab your tickets today: Head to harbourfronttheatre.com or call our box office at 902-888-2500. See you in the lobby!
